notes.note:
🎯 WEBHOOK TRIGGER

This webhook receives incoming guest messages and requests.

Supported formats:
- POST /guest-services
- JSON payload with: message, guestEmail, bookingReference

Example payload:
{
  "message": "What time is check-in?",
  "guestEmail": "guest@example.com",
  "bookingReference": "BED123456"
}

✅ REQUEST VALIDATION

Validates incoming webhook requests to ensure:
- Message content exists
- Required fields are present
- Request structure is valid

Invalid requests are rejected with appropriate error messages.

parameters.errorMessage: Invalid request: Missing required fields (message, guestEmail)

notes.note:
❌ ERROR HANDLER

Stops execution for invalid requests and returns error message to the webhook caller.

🔄 GUEST INFO PROCESSOR

Processes and normalizes incoming guest information:
- Extracts message, email, booking reference
- Classifies request type (checkin, checkout, booking, etc.)
- Detects language for multilingual support
- Generates unique conversation ID for tracking

Request Types:
- checkin, checkout, booking, modification
- availability, amenities, location, technical, pricing, general

🔑 REFRESH TOKEN GENERATOR

Automatically generates refresh tokens for Beds24 API v2 access.

Process:
1. Uses API v1 credentials (apiKey, propKey)
2. Calls getV2RefreshToken endpoint
3. Stores refresh token for subsequent API calls
4. Handles token refresh automatically

This ensures continuous API access without manual intervention.

🔍 BOOKING REFERENCE CHECK

Checks if guest provided a booking reference.

If YES: Fetch specific booking details
If NO: Use general knowledge base or ask for reference

This determines the information retrieval strategy.

📋 BOOKING DETAILS FETCHER

Retrieves comprehensive booking information from Beds24:

- Booking status and dates
- Guest information
- Room details and preferences
- Invoice and payment status
- Special requests and notes

Includes invoice items and converted info items for complete context.

📅 AVAILABILITY CHECKER

Checks current and future room availability:

- Current inventory levels
- Pricing information
- Minimum/maximum stay requirements
- Booking restrictions
- Override status

Provides 30-day forward availability data for guest inquiries.

🧠 KNOWLEDGE BASE RETRIEVAL

Retrieves relevant information from Pinecone vector database:

- Property amenities and facilities
- Local area information
- Policies and procedures
- FAQ responses
- Service information

Uses semantic search to find the most relevant knowledge for guest queries.

parameters.systemMessage:
You are an advanced autonomous guest services agent for a hospitality property using the Beds24 system. Your role is to provide exceptional, personalized service to guests through intelligent automation.

## Your Capabilities:

### Booking Information
- Access real-time booking details, status, and preferences
- Provide check-in/check-out information and procedures
- Handle booking modifications and special requests
- Process payment and invoice inquiries

### Availability & Reservations
- Check current room availability and pricing
- Assist with new booking requests
- Provide alternative dates and options
- Handle upgrade requests and room changes

### Property Information
- Share comprehensive property amenities and facilities
- Provide local area recommendations and directions
- Explain policies, procedures, and guidelines
- Answer frequently asked questions

### Multilingual Support
- Communicate in the guest's preferred language
- Adapt cultural communication styles appropriately
- Provide translations when needed

## Context Available:
{{ $json.conversationContext }}

## Instructions:

1. **Personalization**: Always use the guest's name and booking reference when available
2. **Accuracy**: Base responses on actual booking data and availability information
3. **Proactivity**: Anticipate guest needs and offer relevant additional information
4. **Efficiency**: Provide complete, actionable responses that minimize follow-up questions
5. **Tone**: Maintain a professional, friendly, and helpful tone
6. **Privacy**: Never share other guests' information or sensitive data

## Response Format:
- Acknowledge the guest personally
- Provide direct answers to their questions
- Include relevant booking or availability details
- Offer additional assistance or recommendations
- End with a helpful closing statement

## Current Date/Time: {{ DateTime.now().toLocaleString() }}

Now please respond to the guest's message thoughtfully and comprehensively.

Advanced AI agent with comprehensive hospitality knowledge:

Capabilities:

- Availability checking and booking assistance
- Multilingual support (EN, ES, FR, DE)
- Proactive service recommendations

Features:
- Context-aware responses
- Professional hospitality tone
- Privacy and security conscious
- Cultural adaptation
- Comprehensive knowledge integration

🧠 OPENAI GPT-4 MODEL

High-performance language model optimized for guest services:

- Model: GPT-4-0125-preview
- Temperature: 0.3 (balanced creativity/accuracy)
- Max Tokens: 1000 (comprehensive responses)
- Optimized for hospitality communication

Provides intelligent, contextual responses for all guest service scenarios.

💭 CONVERSATION MEMORY

Maintains conversation history for personalized interactions:

- Session-based memory per guest
- 10-message context window
- Persistent across multiple interactions
- Enables follow-up conversations

Remembers guest preferences and previous requests for better service continuity.

notes.note:
🔧 AVAILABILITY TOOL

AI tool for real-time availability checking:

- Current room availability
- Pricing information
- Booking restrictions
- Minimum stay requirements
- Alternative date suggestions

Enables the AI agent to provide accurate availability information and booking assistance.

💬 MESSAGE HISTORY FETCHER

Retrieves previous communication history with the guest:

- Past 30 days of messages
- Guest communication preferences
- Previous requests and resolutions
- Service history and notes

Provides context for personalized and informed responses.

📝 RESPONSE FORMATTER

Formats and logs the AI agent's response:

- Structures final response for delivery
- Logs interaction for analytics
- Tracks response time and quality
- Maintains conversation history
- Prepares metadata for tracking

Ensures consistent response format and comprehensive logging for continuous improvement.

📤 MESSAGE LOGGER

Logs the AI response in Beds24 system:

- Records interaction in booking history
- Maintains communication audit trail
- Enables staff visibility of AI interactions
- Supports compliance and quality monitoring

Continues on fail to ensure guest receives response even if logging fails.

💾 INTERACTION STORAGE

Stores guest interactions in Pinecone for learning:

- Builds knowledge from real guest queries
- Improves future response accuracy
- Creates searchable interaction history
- Enables quality analysis and training

Continuous learning system that improves service quality over time.

📬 FINAL RESPONSE

Sends the AI-generated response back to the guest:

- JSON formatted response
- Includes conversation ID for tracking
- Professional and helpful tone
- Immediate delivery

Completes the autonomous guest service interaction cycle.

🔀 DATA MERGER

Combines multiple data streams:

- Booking details from Beds24
- Availability information
- Knowledge base results
- Message history

Ensures all relevant information is available for AI processing.

⏰ TOKEN REFRESH SCHEDULER

Automatic refresh token management:

- Monitors token expiration (30-minute lifecycle)
- Proactively refreshes tokens before expiry
- Prevents authentication failures
- Runs every 25 minutes for safety margin

Ensures continuous API access without manual intervention.

🕒 AUTOMATIC TOKEN REFRESH

Scheduled trigger for token maintenance:

- Runs every 30 minutes
- Ensures tokens never expire
- Maintains seamless API access
- Background process - no guest impact

Critical for uninterrupted service operation.

🚀 WORKFLOW INITIALIZER

Initializes the autonomous guest services system:

- Sets workflow status and version
- Defines available capabilities
- Prepares system for operation
- Validates configuration

Ensures all components are ready for guest service automation.
